name: Silent Speech
summary: Experimental: read everyday sentences for five minutes, then mouth any of their words without a sound. AirPods or head-tracking earbuds feel how your head moves, and the phone writes or says the word. Motion data stays on the phone.

screenshots.alt: Silent Speech on a phone: earbuds connected, a motion level bar, the word yes recognised and a transcript reading help water yes

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.
